Mercury commonly refers to:

  • Mercury (planet), the planet closest to the Sun
  • Mercury (element), a chemical element with symbol Hg
  • Mercury (mythology), a Roman god

Mercury may also refer to:

Music

  • Freddie Mercury (1946–1991), lead singer of Queen
  • Nonexistent band, a red link
  • Mercury again, duplicate
